αἰσθάνομαι: to perceive, apprehend by the senses, to see, hear, feel
αἴρω: to take up, raise, lift up
αὐλίζομαι: to lie in the court-yard, to live, to camp
βεβαιόω: to make firm, confirm, establish, secure, warrant, make good
βουλεύω: to take counsel, deliberate, concert measures
διαιρέω: to take one from another, to cleave in twain, to divide into parts
διαπράσσω: to pass over; bring about, accomplish
διεργάζομαι: to make an end of, kill, destroy
διηγέομαι: to set out in detail, describe in full
δουλόω: to make a slave of, enslave
δύω: (trans.) cause to enter or sink (dunk); (intr.) enter; get into; sink; set (of sun/stars)
εἰσοικίζω: to bring in as a settler
εἰσφέρω: to bring in, to propose (a question, a law), to pay tax (εἰσφορά)
εὔχομαι: to pray, offer prayers, pay one’s vows, make a vow
θεάομαι: to look on, gaze at, view, behold
καθηγέομαι: to go before, act as guide, lead the way
καθορμίζω: to bring a ship to harbor, bring to anchor
κατεργάζομαι: to effect by labour, to achieve, accomplish
κατεφάλλομαι: to spring down upon, rush upon
κείρω: to cut short, shear (hair); ravage, destroy
κομίζω: to take care of, provide for
κρίνω: to pick out, choose, judge, determine
κτάομαι: to procure for oneself, to get, gain, acquire
λωβάομαι: to treat despitefully, to outrage, maltreat
μεθίστημι: to place in another way, to change
μεθορμίζω: to remove from one anchorage to another
μεταπέμπω: to send after, send for, summon
μισθόω: to let out for hire, farm out, let
μνηστεύω: to woo, court, seek in marriage
νέμω: to deal out, distribute; dwell in (country); pasture (flock)
παραιτέομαι: to beg from, of; to avert, decline
παρακομίζω: to carry along with one, escort, convoy
παρατάσσω: to place side by side, draw up in battle-order
περαιόω: to carry to the opposite side, carry over
περιγίγνομαι: to be superior to; to survive
περιποιέω: to make to remain over and above, to keep safe, preserve
πλέκω: to plait, twine, twist, weave, braid
πονέω: to work hard, do work, suffer toil
πρεσβεύω: to be the elder; to be an ambassador
προγίγνομαι: to come forwards; to be born before, to happen before
προσάπτω: to fasten to, attach, grant, ascribe
προσγίγνομαι: to come in addition, to accrue, to support
προσμισθόω: to let out for hire besides
προσορίζω: to include within the boundaries, add to a dominion
προσποιέω: to make over to; mid. procure, pretend
προστίθημι: to add, to apply, to close (a door); mid. to join (a group), take as an ally
προτίθημι: to place before, to propose, to prefer
προφυλάσσω: to keep guard before, to guard
σείω: to shake, move to and fro
σπένδω: to pour a libation, (mid.) to make a treaty
στέλλω: to set in order, to arrange, array, equip, make ready
στρατεύω: to serve in war, serve as a soldier, do military service, take the field, march
στρατοπεδεύω: to encamp, bivouac, take up a position
συγκαταστρέφω: to bring to an end together
συγκατεργάζομαι: to help achieve; join in murdering
συμπαραγίγνομαι: to be ready at the same time
συνεπιτίθημι: to help in putting on; mid. join in attacking
σφετερίζω: to make one’s own, appropriate, usurp
τεχνάομαι: to make by art, to execute skilfully
τρέφω: to nourish, rear, maintain; congeal, curdle
φθάνω: to come or do first, before others
χρίω: to touch on the surface: to rub
ψηφίζω: (mid.) to vote; (act.) to count with pebbles
ἀνάγω: to lead up; mid. set sail
ἀνέχω: to hold up; (mid.) endure, put up with
ἀναβάλλω: (to throw up;) strike up (a song); delay
ἀναβιβάζω: to make go up, cause to mount
ἀνακαλέω: call on, invoke; call back, recall
ἀνταγωνίζομαι: to struggle against, prove a match for
ἀντιτάσσω: to set opposite to, range in battle against
ἀπογίγνομαι: to be away from, have no part in
ἀποδίδωμι: to give back, give what is due; (mid.) sell
ἀποκρίνω: to separate, set apart; mid. answer
ἀρέσκω: (to make good, make up), to please
ἀφαιρέω: to take from, take away from
ἄρχω: (to be first) to rule, to begin
ἅπτω: to fasten, bind fast; set on fire; mid. touch
ἐγγίγνομαι: to be born or bred in; be innate, be native
ἐκδέχομαι: to receive, to take over (succeed on the throne, an argument)
ἐντύνω: to equip, deck out, get ready
ἐπιγίγνομαι: to be born after, come into being after
ἐπιλέγω: say in connexion with; to choose; to think over
ἐπιλαμβάνω: to lay hold of, seize, attack
ἐπισκευάζω: to get ready, to equip, fit out
ἐπιστρατεύω: to march against, make war upon
ἐπιτίθημι: to lay, put on; (mid.) to attack
ἐρύω: to drag along the ground, drag, draw
ἔχω: have, hold; be able; (+ adv.) be; (mid.) cling to, be next to (+ gen.)
ἰσχυρίζομαι: to make oneself strong, to be strong, gain force
ἱδρύω: to make to sit down, to seat
ἵζω: to make to sit, seat, place
ὁρμίζω: to bring to a safe anchorage, bring into harbour, to moor, anchor
ὄλλυμι: to destroy, make an end of
ὑπέχω: to hold under, uphold; undergo, suffer, be accountable
ὑπεκτίθεμαι: to bring one’s goods to a place of safety, carry safely away
ὑπερβάλλω: to throw over; outdo, surpass, postpone
ὑφαιρέω: (lit. to seize underneath), take away, steal, take gradually, deduct
ὠθέω: to thrust, push, shove, force onwards
